# title: Fixture: The Cabinet Hearing
# source_url: fixture://tests/fixtures/transcripts/S00E01.txt
[A cabinet rattles.]
QUILL: Please unfold the meeting rug. Our cabinet is humming again.
MICA: Is it humming in a major key?
QUILL: The fog kind.
FINCH: I brought a tuning fork.
LUMEN: Finch, that fork is made of wax.
FINCH: I collect jars of fog, and I label them by pitch.
FINCH: That's what fog choir practice is for.
ORBIT: I can hear it through my hat.
MICA: Your hat has a built-in trumpet.
ORBIT: The trumpet is purely ceremonial.
LUMEN: This rug is calling for a recess.
QUILL: Lumen, the rug has a vote.
LUMEN: It keeps voting for Thursdays!
FINCH: Motion to fold the rug.
